item.title: Rulelink CLI Unreleased
item.description:
Added

  • Add init command, Rule model v1 and canonical Source writer
  • Add the rules add command
  • Add rules approve, reject and obsolete
  • Search and filter Rules, and record related Rules
  • Add rules format
  • Add where and the annotation scan
  • Publish shell and PowerShell installers
